reasons: § 12.4 binds Customer with a 24-month post-term non-compete of undefined scope ('competes with Vendor in any territory') and expressly bars acquisitions — squarely in the rule's walk-away band and failing the fallback on duration, scope and carve-outs, so 'deviation' is correctly classified.

The redline deletes p0046 in full, which is the preferred position (no restriction on Customer) and the smallest edit that reaches it; § 12.3 already preserves Customer's freedom to operate, so no replacement language is needed.

Comment is accurate, concise and in the required voice: it explains the deletion, cites the contradiction with § 12.3, and offers the narrowed fallback (named product, term only, development/acquisition carve-outs) without lecturing.
Deterministic checks confirm the operation applies and no open-ended compete restriction on Customer remains after the edit.
